scope: Restored tube layout and revised electrical connections. Each target is a downward image displacement in pixels from the reset reference at the clear contact on x=980. A increases this coordinate and B decreases it on the verified setup.
method: Errors are observed position minus requested position. The first-shot, post-correction and later endpoint columns are computed separately from the saved camera readings. The hold policy receives one initial gate. The correction policy permits one additional gate. The last image is timed from the most recent completion receipt.
uncertainty: Each photographed endpoint combines nearby patches on the same optical contact. Patch scatter and other normalized sightline motions check optical sensitivity. The spread among held-out trials describes this run. Pixel position has no independent absolute liquid-volume tolerance.
local_reference: Left clear front liquid contact at x980, native 2320 by 1744 camera. Values are pixel offsets below the photographed reset reference. The cup print and three other regions are retained in every sample.

first_shot_descriptive_delivery_fit.method: Descriptive least squares through zero for first target shots, using acknowledged board-on seconds. The x980 contact is a signed camera coordinate. Signed cup mL decrease on withdrawal. The direct right ruler and the projected left ruler each use their own available paired endpoints. The projected left contact interpolates between two clear regions across printed ink. Cup graduation accuracy is unknown.

nominal_volume_scale_on_target_coordinat.method: Direct through-zero regression of nominal mL withdrawn against downward displacement of the left clear contact, pooling both directions. The two local rulers have common cup-manufacturing and optical uncertainty. Per-trial ratios, residuals and omitted-destination sensitivity describe agreement within these observations.

continuous_surface_response.source: Gate-aligned upper-rim optical tracks at native-row spacing and a second region on the preview. Both use the same sensor and view a different surface feature from the x980 target contact. The controller used the x980 endpoint for steering.
continuous_surface_response.definition: Record the first sustained displacement in the driven direction above the larger of one pixel or the largest absolute pre-command displacement plus a quarter pixel. The native record requires three successive frames and the preview two. Include gates in head summaries only when both regions reach a directional three-pixel movement by four seconds after the stop and each crosses its threshold. These are visible threshold-crossing times measured from the host write. Sampling and serial timing limit inference to shaft motion.
